relevance_note: Prospective follow-up of 7 LAMP2 cardiomyopathy probands with per-patient data and variants in Table 1 ("Clinical, demographic and outcome data were assembled for the 7 affected proband").
method_note: Built with a short Python script (scratch dir) from my own reading of the paper; the script only cut Table 1 row spans (row label through the patient's cell) and copied values I typed; every value was checked against Table 1 by eye and every span was checked to occur verbatim. Table 1 has patients as columns; the column header is bare numbers 1-7. Labels: the text itself says "patient #1" (and "#2 in Table 1", "patients #1 and #2") and "patient #7", so those three use rule 1 ("patient #1", "patient #2", "patient #7"); columns 3-6 are never labelled in the text and are "Table 1 #3" to "Table 1 #6". Relatives from the "Family history of cardiomyopathy" row: "Brother: WPW/LVH Aunt: WPW" (column 2) and "Mother: dilated CM/transplant" (column 4) get their own rows; their LAMP2 status is not stated, so they have no variant rows. The 7 asymptomatic "female LAMP2 obligate carriers (age range 19-51 years) in 2 of the families" are described only as a group and get no rows. Table legend "+ = present; 0=absent" is quoted with every 0 cell used as excluded. LV outflow gradient 0 mm Hg at rest is recorded as a resting-gradient feature excluded, but the checklist LVOT obstruction item is left not reported for those patients (no provoked data; narrower than the checklist item). Genetic transmission "Maternal" (columns 2, 4, 5) recorded as inherited maternal from the table cell; no parental genotype testing is described, so parental_testing_statement is not reported; "Sporadic" is not recorded as de novo. Variant strings are non-HGVS (e.g. "Y109", "IVSG-2A→G" as printed); protein-like strings (Y109, K289FS, V310I) also put in protein_hgvs_as_stated; no variant type derived. Group statements used: "diffuse and marked LV hypertrophy in each patient", "All 7 patients developed marked LV systolic dysfunction", and "All had ... without mental retardation, neurological or musculoskeletal deficits" (excludes skeletal myopathy; the intellectual-disability checklist item is left not reported because mental retardation is narrower than that composite item). Serum enzymes row (footnote: creatine kinase and alanine aminotransferase elevated by >=2) gives elevated CK and ALT observed (+) or excluded (0). Increased ECG voltages are not assigned per patient (text gives them for the 6 pre-excitation patients only as a group). Second autopsy heart (weight 1265 g) is not assigned: the text does not say which patient it is, and Figure 3 says "same patient shown in Figure 1", which is the ECG of #2, while the autopsy context suggests patient #1. Contradictions: (1) text says 65 mm thickness at age 15 for patient #1/#2 pairing ("60 mm and 65 mm at age 23 and 15 years ... patients #1 and #2") whereas Table 1 gives patient #1 dying at 12 (Figure 2: 12-year-old boy, 65 mm); (2) footnote says radio frequency ablation at age 14 in patient #1, who died at 12; (3) text gives ejection fraction 20-35% but Table 1 lists 36 (#1) and 15 (#6); (4) footnote says enzyme isoforms indicated musculoskeletal and liver involvement while the text says all had no musculoskeletal deficits and the Discussion says "largely without" hepatic involvement or overt skeletal myopathy; (5) table note cites the prior report as "(1,11)" but ref 11 is an unrelated sarcomere study; prior report recorded as ref 1. Heart failure checklist set observed only for the four HF deaths (#2, #4, #5, #6); #7 (NYHA III, transplant) left not reported.
